thread:
morgan: Kicking off phased rollout now — slices: US -> EU -> APAC. Change window 02:00-06:00 UTC. Canary slice = 5% traffic per region.
raj: 👍 Confirming capacity numbers: US warm pool 120 vcores / 40 GPUs available; EU 60 vcores / 20 GPUs; APAC 30 vcores / 8 GPUs.
sylvie: Thanks. Can we pin EU to model:v2.3-stable for first 2 hours due to compliance customers? If issues, we'll switch to v2.2-hot.
morgan: Yes pin EU to v2.3-stable, unpinned after 2h if no regressions. US/APAC will go v2.4-canary -> v2.4.
kevin: deploy-bot, start canary in US slice 1
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Starting rollout: region=us slice=1 target=5% model=v2.4-canary. Canary timeout=30m. Logs: https://ci.internal/deploy/5412309876
anna: Running quick smoke: p95 latency baseline 210ms, error rate <0.2%, token throughput 18k tps across canary pool.
raj: SRE note: thermal headroom across US cluster is 18% (safe). Watch queue depth; autoscale threshold set at queue>300.
sylvie: Rollout acceptance criteria reminder: error rate <=0.5% delta vs baseline, p95 delta <= +250ms, model-quality regression <= 1% on eval prompts. If breached -> rollback.
morgan: Documenting rollback triggers here so ops can act quickly.
kevin: Quick commands if we need to pin/rollback:
kevin: ```
# pin EU to previous
redwoodctl rollout set --region eu --model v2.3-stable --pin 2h
# immediate rollback whole region
redwoodctl rollback --region eu --to v2.3-stable --reason "error-rate-spike"
```
anna: Noted. We'll run the A/B quality checks after 15m.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] US slice=1 reached 5% traffic, canary-monitor: ok so far (error-rate 0.18%, p95 230ms).
raj: Good. Proceed US -> increase to 25% in 10m if metrics stable.
morgan: Proceeding with phased ramp. EU canary scheduled 15m after US ramp.
sylvie: Reminder for APAC: warm pool is small — will only go to 5% then hold for manual approval. No auto-increase.
kevin: If EU shows small quality regression (<0.7%) we will hold and run targeted evals. Anything >1% -> rollback.
anna: We saw a tiny auth token spike in EU canary logs earlier this week — ops will watch auth error rate closely.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] EU slice=1 started (pinned model=v2.3-stable). Traffic=5%.
raj: EU capacity check: added 4 standby instances to EU warm pool; projected cushion ~12%.
morgan: Ok team — criteria all clear for US ramp to 25%. APAC remains manual. Keep alerts loud (pager on). Update in this thread with any deviations.
kevin: If rollback happens, preferred flow: pin -> roll back -> notify support -> run rollback postmortem. Keep timestamps in the deploy ticket.
sylvie: Copy. I'll keep the quality dashboard open and post screenshots if any drift.
anna: 02:45 UTC update: US at 25% steady for 20m, metrics within thresholds. EU at 5% pinned and stable. APAC holding at 0% awaiting manual go.
morgan: Thanks — will initiate EU hold review at +1h and then decide whether to unpin. Proceeding to document release notes and send to #product after change window.
raj: One more note: if any region hits queue >600 or GPU saturation >92%, we stop increases immediately.
morgan: Closing loop — next post will be status at +1h or earlier if any signal. :rocket:
